prompts.photo:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: Original landscape artwork for a creative desktop app's Photo studio showcase.
Primary request: A breathtaking cinematic coastal mountain road at golden hour. An elegant winding ribbon of asphalt threads through rugged green headlands above a deep blue sea; layers of distant mountains and sunlit cliffs create expansive depth. The road should have credible engineering and natural perspective, and act as a graceful leading line into the landscape.
Style/medium: Photorealistic editorial landscape, nuanced natural light, tangible rock and vegetation detail, fine atmospheric haze, tasteful film-like color. Warm apricot sun on the cliff faces against cool lavender-blue shadows. Rich and compelling without exaggerated HDR.
Composition/framing: Landscape 16:10, full bleed, elevated wide viewpoint, carefully balanced dramatic diagonal coastline and road, detailed foreground and atmospheric horizon. Artwork only.
Constraints: Original fictional location. No people, vehicles, buildings, brand marks, advertising, signs, lettering, logos, signatures, borders, UI or watermarks. No text at all.
prompts.pixel:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Original expressive digital painting for a creative desktop app's Pixel studio showcase.
Primary request: A sophisticated botanical painting of oversized iris flowers, with sculptural indigo and lavender petals opening through energetic abstract brushwork. A few slender sage stems and leaves lead through the composition. The iris forms remain beautifully recognizable while their edges dissolve into confident patches of paint.
Style/medium: Contemporary painterly fine art; tactile pigment, thick palette-knife ridges, translucent washes, dry-brush scratches and exposed canvas. Varied mark sizes and deliberate painterly imperfections. Visually rich, expressive and mature.
Color palette: Luminous lavender, deep ink blue, periwinkle, muted sage and small warm coral accents, balanced with chalky ivory and soft dark mauve. Not a simple gradient.
Composition/framing: Landscape 16:10, full bleed, asymmetrical close-up with one generous main bloom and supporting partial blooms, rhythmic negative space, strong silhouette and layered detail that remains beautiful at thumbnail size. Artwork only, no frame.
Constraints: Completely original composition. No letters, words, logos, watermarks, signatures, captions, borders, UI or typography. No text at all.
